neighbours.label: the copula 'be' / 'are' / 'been' introducing a predicate (especially infinitive 'to be' after 'means to', 'consider X to', 'must')
fire: The novel shows what it was like to be a child in wartime Berlin.
Many farmers consider the river to be a sacred part of their land.
Applicants for the post must be fluent in both French and German.
Students discussed what it means to be a citizen in a democracy.
The committee found the evidence to be incomplete and asked for more.
All drivers must be insured before they take the car on public roads.
Few people expected the experiment to be so successful.
Visitors who are aware of the rules rarely cause any problems.
quiet: The novel shows how a child grew up in wartime Berlin.
Many farmers have used the river for irrigation for centuries.
Applicants for the post should send a letter to the director.
Students discussed how citizens vote in a democracy.
The committee read the evidence carefully and asked for more.
All drivers need insurance before they take the car on public roads.
Few people expected the experiment to succeed so quickly.
Visitors who follow the rules rarely cause any problems.

notes: Card: ' be' x13, ' been' x4, ' are', ' is', ' being', ' become'. - pole: verbs/prepositions in ranking statements ('had the second most').
